_comment: Every public claim carries an executable probe. Probe exits 0 = the claim is still true. Checked by `reconcile`. Seeded 2026-08-20 when the frost briefing gained real Claude conversation data; README claims still need probes as they are touched.

claims.claim: frost briefing renders real Claude conversations (title, active time, est. cost, resume command), not shell-history guesses
claims.probe: rg -q 'Conversations · last 7 days' internal/briefing/briefing.go && rg -q 'claude --resume' internal/briefing/briefing.go && rg -q 'loadClaudeConvos' internal/briefing/claude.go

claims.claim: briefing cost estimates dedupe streamed content-block lines by message id (one API response counted once)
briefing time is active time with idle gaps excluded, not wall-clock span
dashboard ledger panel is backed by an in-repo writer

claims.probe: rg -q 'scrub\.Slice' internal/capture/capture.go && rg -q 'scrub\.Text\(children' internal/capture/capture.go && go test ./internal/scrub -run 'TestText_ProvenEscapes|TestText_KeepsExistingCoverage|TestCommand_FlagStyleSecrets|TestMap_RedactsSecretKeys|TestSlice_ScrubsEachLine' >/dev/null 2>&1
